reason: The cited evidence (E1) only addresses oscillatory sintering of Mo-Si-B alloys doped with ZrB2, not single-phase ZrB2. It does not support the claimed mechanism in pure ZrB2, the predicted mechanical parity, the ~80% oxidation improvement, or liquid metal corrosion resistance, leaving all key premises unsupported by specific prior evidence.
premises: Oscillatory pressure sintering refines microstructure and enhances densification at lower temperatures
Grain refinement and improved bonding reduce porosity and promote protective oxide formation
Refined ZrB2 will show mechanical properties comparable to high-temperature sintered samples
Oxidation mass loss will be reduced by ~80% as in Mo-Si-B alloys
Improved liquid metal corrosion resistance results from denser, finer-grained structure
